releaseNotes:
Warrior TV Player 0.9.0

- Settings > Account shows your time left, end date, billing and your TV ID.
- Renew from your phone: scan the QR code on the TV and pay by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay or Link, once or with auto-renew. The TV updates by itself within seconds.
- Reminders 7, 3 and 1 days before your time ends, and on the last day.
- When your time runs out, viewing pauses until you renew. Your profiles, favorites, progress and settings are all kept.
- Warrior TV Player is a player only: no channels, content or IPTV subscriptions are sold or included.
